## 中文

`v0.8.1` 优化了模型与推理强度弹层的主题适配，让菜单外观更贴合 DSH 自带界面。

### 更新内容

- 菜单采用 DSH 原生的半透明背景、背景模糊和浮层阴影，浅色与深色均跟随当前主题。
- 修正无效的背景变量，避免菜单始终使用写死的兜底颜色。
- 移除额外的实体边框，统一弹层边缘效果。
- 修正警告提示的主题变量名称，使文字与背景颜色正确适配主题。

菜单的位置、尺寸、打开动画及交互方式保持不变。

### 安装或更新

Web Profile 支持 DSH `0.2.0-rc.1`、`0.2.0-rc.2`：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:HanaAyane/dsh-reasoning-effort#v0.8.1
```

安装后重启 DSH Web Host 并刷新页面。

DSH Desktop `0.2.0-rc.2`：先完全退出桌面应用，再使用 **Desktop 内置的 dsh 命令**执行：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:HanaAyane/dsh-reasoning-effort#v0.8.1
dsh plugin --profile desktop list
```

安装后重新打开桌面应用。Web 与 Desktop 的插件安装状态独立；请勿用 npm 版 dsh 修改 Desktop Profile。详见 [桌面端安装说明](https://github.com/HanaAyane/dsh-reasoning-effort#dsh-桌面端安装)。

附件 `dsh-reasoning-effort-0.8.1.tgz` 为本版本插件包。DSH `0.1.x` 用户请继续使用 [v0.7.3](https://github.com/HanaAyane/dsh-reasoning-effort/releases/tag/v0.7.3)。

## English

`v0.8.1` improves the model and reasoning-effort menu's theme integration so its appearance matches DSH's native interface more closely.

### Changes

- Use DSH's native translucent fill, backdrop blur, and elevation shadow in both light and dark themes.
- Replace the undefined background token so the menu follows the active theme instead of always using hardcoded fallback colors.
- Remove the extra solid border and use the theme's elevation shadow to define the menu edge.
- Correct the warning color tokens so warning text and backgrounds follow the theme.

Menu position, size, opening animation, and interaction remain unchanged.

### Install or update

The Web Profile supports DSH `0.2.0-rc.1` and `0.2.0-rc.2`:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:HanaAyane/dsh-reasoning-effort#v0.8.1
```

Restart the DSH Web Host and refresh the page after installation.

For DSH Desktop `0.2.0-rc.2`, fully quit the app, then use the **Desktop bundled dsh command**:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:HanaAyane/dsh-reasoning-effort#v0.8.1
dsh plugin --profile desktop list
```

Reopen the app after installation. Web and Desktop keep separate plugin installation state; do not modify the Desktop Profile with an npm-installed dsh. See the [Desktop installation instructions](https://github.com/HanaAyane/dsh-reasoning-effort/blob/main/README.en.md#install-in-dsh-desktop).

The attached `dsh-reasoning-effort-0.8.1.tgz` is the package for this release. DSH `0.1.x` users should continue using [v0.7.3](https://github.com/HanaAyane/dsh-reasoning-effort/releases/tag/v0.7.3).
